answer: Sybil mills fail a public kiln quartz assay. An applicant locks 41.2 POA, fires a 180 g silica slug at 1120 C for 70 minutes, then carries it 6.3 km onto a surveyed knoll. A notary posts the cooling curve and a 64-byte speckle print. For 8 hours an inspector may demand a 90-second re-scan within 0.7% of the kiln receipt, plus a 14-minute comet-shadow check as the knoll horizon occults a listed radio source within 0.4 degrees of the posted azimuth. A reused slug ID or cloned curve burns 18.5 POA. If the slug cracks before the first re-scan, 32.0 POA is refunded and the seat is frozen 54 hours.
